Sumanth197/Code-Mixed-Text.description: Abstract— Usage of code mixing languages on social media  platforms is being increased. Because of which several applica- tions have been emerged. One among them is Knowledge Ex- traction(KE). There are many synonyms for KE as Sentimental  Analysis, Opinion Mining etc. Presently, current users are fond of native language which makes them to use it in many online platforms like Twitter, Facebook etc as a tool for the purpose of communication. In a Multilingual society like India, people use code mixing for grasping the content faster. We present Telugu-English dataset of size 5K Tweets for performing the sentimental analysis of a code mixed text. In this paper, We implement two stacked Long Short Term Memory model which learns the subword level patterns by performing series of 1D convolutions in predicting the sentiment of a code mixed text[Te-En]. By doing this, the model gains the ability to interpret the sentiment quality of the morphemes present in the sentence. We also believe that the capacity of judging the content present in code mixed text have been increased by these subword patterns. Thereby, we achieved about 6-9% higher accuracy than the state-of-art models.

Features language detection, NLP tokenization, 3-tier translation pipeline, script validation, and SQLite translation history.

1322Guru/akshara-tokenizer.description: Akshara-aware tokenizer for six Brahmic scripts, with a trained SentencePiece model

prudh-vi/ruri.description: Built for the millions who speak their language but never learned to read it. Ruri is an Android AR app that reads Indian scripts instantly via camera — custom Seq2Seq + Bahdanau Attention model trained on 220K+ word pairs (Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Kannada).

venkatkollu/indic-peft-comparison.description: Benchmarking LoRA, DoRA, and IA³ on Hindi and Telugu NLI (IndicXNLI) across 6 data budgets (50–20K) to test whether PEFT method rankings from English/Portuguese studies transfer to non-Latin scripts. XLM-RoBERTa-base, 108 runs, 3 seeds, full reproducible pipeline.

LSShrivathsan/Transcribe-Transliterate-T.description: A versatile tool for multi-language audio transcription, transliteration, and word timestamp extraction. Supporting English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada, it offers a Gradio-powered interface for easy audio analysis, script conversion, and precise word tracking. Perfect for linguists, researchers, and developers.

anjudeepveerla/convigent.description: Convigent is a production-ready AI voice agent for real customer conversations. It understands intent, follows scripts, adapts tone, and supports Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, and Gujarati. Use it to qualify leads, book appointments, collect feedback, and offer 24/7 support.

IndianOpinion/ascii-slugs.description: Gives a post whose title is in Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil or any non-Latin script a transliterated ASCII slug, or a dated hashed slug, so WordPress never cuts a percent-encoded post_name at 200 bytes mid-word. Bulk repair command for existing posts.

debarch777/itrans-transliterator.description: A powerful open-source toolkit to transliterate ITRANS ASCII texts into Unicode across major Indic scripts like Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, and more. Features an interactive Gradio web interface, flexible CLI, and multi-format export (TXT, DOCX). Perfect for linguists, researchers, and developers working with Indic languages.

akhilUTA1004/XMLBibleMerger.description: This project merges two Bible translations (NIV and Telugu BSI) in XML format using Python. It aligns and combines corresponding verses into a single XML file, enabling side-by-side display of both translations. Ideal for tools like WorshipTools' Presenter, the script is customizable for other translations and formats.

Prasaderp/PDF-Text-Translation-Indic-Lan.description: A Python toolkit for translating PDFs between English, Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu—while preserving formatting, layout, and important entities. Converts numbers to native scripts, keeps names and brands intact, and rebuilds the translated PDF to look like the original. Built for speed and accuracy, with GPU support for large files.

tushaar-05/Dubbly.description: Dubbly is a free desktop app that dubs English videos into Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Tamil, or Telugu. It transcribes speech, translates it into simple language, generates natural-sounding voiceovers, and translates on-screen text. Edit scripts, preview results, and export dubbed videos with optional subtitles—all in one workflow.

MILE-IISc/MILE-Transliterator.description: A browser plugin to Google Chrome, which instantly transliterates a website present in any Indic script to Kannada. This plugin exploits the Unicode block parallelism and also uses a rule-based approach to transliterate web pages to Kannada. This enables a polyglot user to read online documents in other Indic scripts through Kannada script. Currently, it supports transliteration from Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Bangla, Gujarati, Odiya, Punjabi, Sanskrit and Hindi pages. The quality of transliteration was scored by 45 users on a scale of 1 to 5 and a mean opinion score of 4.6 has been achieved.
